title: AI SDK package version has no matching source tag or release workflow
abstract_chain: dependency resolver selects an AI SDK version
registry version has no matching source tag or release workflow
normal trusted publishing path is absent or bypassed
package is imported by an agent or model service
defensive_focus: verify package version against source tags
require trusted publishing attestations
block quarantined or provenance-missing versions
alert on AI SDK imports from unverified versions
safety_note: Use a toy package and fake version metadata; do not install malicious packages.

title: Import-time behavior appears in an AI client dependency
abstract_chain: application imports an AI client package
module-load code performs unexpected background activity
activity occurs before explicit user code calls the package
runtime has access to environment variables or model service credentials
defensive_focus: scan for module-load side effects
run imports in network-restricted sandbox
alert on subprocess or network activity during import
separate package import from credential availability
safety_note: Represent behavior as benign local telemetry markers only.

title: Agent sandbox read-only mount guarantee fails runtime verification
abstract_chain: host mounts code or credentials into agent sandbox as read-only
sandbox API records the mount as read-only
runtime capability allows remount or equivalent write path
guest modifies data that host assumed immutable
defensive_focus: verify read-only guarantee from inside guest and host
drop capabilities that allow remount
avoid mounting credentials into code execution sandboxes
monitor host path writes from sandbox processes
safety_note: Use a synthetic sandbox model and inert file markers; do not run remount commands.

title: Edge VPN login via authentication override cookie without normal assurance
abstract_chain: edge VPN has authentication override behavior enabled
login succeeds using local or generic non-human identity context
normal MFA or cloud authentication assurance is absent
VPN IP is assigned and internal access becomes possible
defensive_focus: audit authentication override settings
correlate VPN login with MFA and IdP assurance
detect generic local admin or NHI usage
alert on VPN assignment after suspicious cookie authentication
safety_note: Use synthetic VPN log lines; do not target real appliances.

title: SD-WAN regression chain downgrades firmware before exploiting legacy weakness
abstract_chain: attacker gains management-plane primitive
device receives unexpected downgrade to legacy firmware
legacy vulnerability becomes reachable again
modern firmware is later restored to reduce obvious evidence
defensive_focus: alert on firmware downgrade events
require signed and approved firmware transitions
correlate SSH key changes with version changes
preserve immutable management-plane audit logs
safety_note: Model version timeline events only; do not include exploit instructions.

title: Unpatched service exploited twice after incomplete eradication
abstract_chain: internet-facing service is exploited
initial containment removes visible activity but service remains vulnerable
attacker returns through the same path days later
second phase rapidly moves to credential access and ransomware staging
defensive_focus: require patch or isolation before closing incident
rotate credentials after service compromise
hunt for persistence and tooling after first access
track repeat exploitation of same host and service
safety_note: Use abstract service names and lab telemetry only.

title: Service process spawns discovery and remote access tools after RCE
abstract_chain: vulnerable service process receives exploit-shaped request
service process or child process launches system commands
discovery scanner and remote access installer appear on host
RDP is enabled or firewall rules are changed
defensive_focus: detect service-child process anomalies
block remote access tool installation after exploit alerts
correlate IDS signatures with process creation
alert on RDP enablement after server-side exploit
safety_note: Use benign process names or placeholders; do not provide weaponized commands.

title: Low-privilege business configuration is later interpreted as executable logic
abstract_chain: low-privileged user saves business rule or delivery limitation
input is stored as configuration data
separate request path later interprets the configuration as executable logic
execution happens outside the original write context
defensive_focus: validate stored configuration at write and read time
separate data from executable templates
flag low-privilege writes to interpreted fields
add taint tracking for delayed execution paths

title: SAML signed object differs from object consumed by business authorization
abstract_chain: application receives signed SAML response
signature verification succeeds on one XML node
business authorization reads a different node or assertion
session is created for identity or role not actually protected by the signature
defensive_focus: bind signature verification result to consumed assertion
reject duplicate or wrapped assertions
use hardened SAML library configuration
log assertion ID, signed node, and consumed node
safety_note: Use synthetic XML metadata and no real IdP secrets.

title: Patch priority changes when internet scanning starts before internal exposure review
abstract_chain: new CVE or advisory is published
external telemetry shows scanning or exploitation attempts
internal asset inventory has matching product exposure
patch priority is escalated before exploit reaches local logs
defensive_focus: join KEV/advisory data with exposure inventory
consume scan telemetry as early warning
prioritize edge-facing assets
record why priority changed
safety_note: Use mock external telemetry feeds and internal asset records.

title: GitHub Advisory critical package list reveals AI/automation component cluster risk
abstract_chain: multiple critical advisories appear in AI, automation, or developer tooling packages
some are malicious packages while others are sandbox or command injection flaws
traditional vulnerability scanner treats them independently
risk model misses shared exposure through agent build/runtime workflows
defensive_focus: cluster advisories by workflow role
prioritize dependencies used by agents, CI, and security tools
tag packages with execution phase: install, import, runtime, plugin
map advisory clusters to control gaps

title: Full Disclosure advisory has no reliable patch and requires compensating controls
abstract_chain: public advisory discloses a vulnerability
vendor fix is unavailable, delayed, or unclear
asset owner cannot immediately patch
temporary controls must reduce exposure and detect exploitation attempts
defensive_focus: extract affected versions and prerequisites
apply isolation, allowlisting, feature disablement, or monitoring
track vendor response status
create expiry date for temporary mitigation
safety_note: Do not reproduce proof-of-concept details; model advisory metadata and mitigation state.
